grounding.observation: 341 approves two corrections after340's explicit failure to perform the promised native neutral proof. The new recipe loads actual rest-body data into a separate proof scene, not the posed donor Basis.
grounding.comparison: The broad appearance task and all earlier failures remain unchanged; this admits only its garment prerequisite.

expert_coverage.observation: Continuous anatomical shoulder topology, bounded ease/clearance, physical settling, explicit supports and revealing three-view review test the actual fit dependency.
expert_coverage.comparison: Body-derived construction can still look like a bodysuit; physical stability cannot waive that visible failure.

film_alignment.observation: Accepted Pashtun remains final visible quality authority. Plain neutral studio cloth is explicitly a construction test, not same-film finish.
film_alignment.comparison: No face/crown/saddle or production image is being claimed complete.

preferences.observation: No routine technical handoff. Neutral images must be internally credible before using the remaining correction for bending.
preferences.comparison: No repetition of340's mathematical-rest substitution or whole-crowd dependency.

reference_roles.observation: Actual neutral donor supplies anatomy; Pashtun supplies eventual quality floor; reference rearing remains action authority for downstream integration.
reference_roles.comparison: A neutral fit test does not reproduce that action or replace its authority.

method.observation: Reviewed fixed handler physically settles a continuous neutral shell against the actual rest body, retains raw/final arrays, saves and renders via the admitted bridge. The method intentionally replaces rectangular armhole panels with existing continuous topology.
method.comparison: This is not flat garment manufacturing or a promise that donor-derived cloth will look natural. Reject anatomy embossing, pinching and clipping from actual saved images.

interfaces.observation: Neutral shoulder/armpit/collar/waist/cuff are explicit prerequisites. The next bend cannot run until neutral visuals pass; old207-pose caches and crowd are not changed.
interfaces.comparison: The standalone proof does not qualify downstream pose transfer, sash or saddle fit.

efficient_quality.observation: One real neutral garment and three serial640-square diagnostic views avoid full-scene rendering and premature cast propagation.
efficient_quality.comparison: No cost or quality success is inferred from fewer renders or test counts.

authority.observation: Same appearance task18/max19 under explicit341 approval. No providers, purchases, upload, motion allowance change or accepted-master edit.
authority.comparison: Native failure consumes this correction; no automatic reset or extension.

strongest_counterexample: A numerically stable, saved cloth shell can still look like a muscular bodysuit or have pinched armpits and floating cuffs. That fails neutral visual review and blocks bending; studio pictures cannot be promoted into finished Nihang appearance.
